claims.claim: urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests.
claims.citation: urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests

claims.claim: urllib3's automatic retry mechanism also handles redirects.
claims.citation: This same mechanism also handles redirects

claims.claim: Retries can be controlled using the retries parameter to request() in urllib3.
claims.citation: control the retries using the retries parameter to request()

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 will follow up to 3 redirects.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times and follow up to 3 redirects.

claims.claim: Specifying an integer for the retries parameter changes the number of retries in urllib3.
claims.citation: To change the number of retries just specify an integer

claims.claim: Specifying retries=False disables all retry and redirect logic in urllib3.
claims.citation: To disable all retry and redirect logic specify retries=False

claims.claim: Specifying redirect=False disables redirects while keeping the retrying logic in urllib3.
claims.citation: To disable redirects but keep the retrying logic, specify redirect=False

claims.claim: A Retry instance can be used for more granular control of retries in urllib3.
claims.citation: For more granular control you can use a Retry instance

claims.claim: Exceptions for too many redirects can be disabled to return the 302 response in urllib3.
claims.citation: disable exceptions for too many redirects and just return the 302 response

claims.claim: A retry policy can be specified at the PoolManager level to apply to all requests in urllib3.
claims.citation: If you want all requests to be subject to the same retry policy, you can specify the retry at the PoolManager level

claims.claim: A PoolManager pool-level retry policy in urllib3 can be overridden by specifying retries to request().
claims.citation: override this pool-level retry policy by specifying retries to request()
